findings.text: The approved typed public contract is not implemented at the SLICE-002 boundary: src/ReplicatedStorage/Client/UI/Config/WindowTypes.luau exports WindowConstructionContext with Navigator: any and Elements: any, WindowConfig with any-valued definitions, and WindowDefinition.CreateView consumes that weakened context. The specification requires the public typed surface to contain no any and defines these as WindowNavigatorPort, UiElementContext, and opaque ErasedWindowDefinition associations. As written, a concrete window definition or typed caller receives no static protection for the navigation/element capabilities it is allowed to use, so TS-STATIC-001 cannot establish the required typed API contract. Replace the exported any fields with the canonical narrow types while keeping runtime values and ownership unchanged.

review-g191-fcd853b75505-result.resolution: Route the observed post-yield owner/generation/deadline validation defect to bounded SLICE-003 Engineering remediation and require fresh Review and QA.

findings.text: WindowNavigator accepts a yielding Open or Close as successful without rechecking the operation owner, generation, or absolute deadline after the hook settles. runHook can return Success after the deadline, and _add/_close/_replace then immediately publish lifecycle, mutate stack/handles, or resume lower windows; Destroy can likewise clear _operation while a hook is running and the resumed caller still continues. This violates the approved requirement that every post-yield commit revalidate gate owner, generation, and deadline, and permits a real late continuation to mutate a torn-down or expired navigation operation. Add the same-generation/deadline check at each post-transition boundary and route stale/expired results through the specified timeout/recovery path.
